text:
Erica (Marketing): Thinking about a more hands-on webinar that sells via value — title idea: 'Live Lab: Cut inference cost with caching & batching (real demos)'. Short, tactical, lots of demos. Thoughts? :lab_coat:
Nate (Producer): love it. audience? who are we recruiting — infra engineers, platform teams, product ML?
Erica (Marketing): primary: infra/platform engineers & ML engs at startups + mid-market. want it practical: configs, SLO tradeoffs, and a small billing/forecast section.
Mike (APM): I can do a 10-min demo showing prefix caching + autoscale behavior. I'll need a reproducible workload and a fallback plan if GPUs flaky.
Alyssa (Growth): CTA strategy: capture intent via two CTAs — "Get trial capacity" and "Request on-prem consult". route high-intent (trial + >10k tokens/day) to SDR queue. Can we add an embed for quick eval? :thinking_face:
Sarah (Product): agree on CTAs. For speakers: Mike + either Jordan (runtime lead) or Priya (SRE). We should limit slide count (6 max) and have a one-paragraph abstract for each speaker.
Nate (Producer): rehearsal windows: Tue 9-11am PT or Wed 4-6pm PT. Which works? We need a dry run with network sim and a prerecorded fallback.
deploy-bot: scheduled message: rehearsal booked for 2025-10-15T16:00:00Z in #green-room (auto-created).
Mike (APM): fallback plan — if live GPU demo fails, switch to short prerecorded clip + live walkthrough of the command log. I'll upload clip to s3://redwood-webinars/live-lab/demo-cache.mp4 ahead of time.
Erica (Marketing): run-of-show suggestion:
```
00:00 - 02:00 - intro + agenda
02:00 - 12:00 - demo 1: prefix caching (Mike)
12:00 - 22:00 - demo 2: batching & autoscale (Jordan)
22:00 - 27:00 - cost playbook & forecasting (Erica)
27:00 - 40:00 - live Q&A + quick polls
40:00 - 45:00 - close + CTAs
```
Alyssa (Growth): inbound routing rules (first pass):
- tag=webinar_live_lab
- intent=trial_request OR consult_request
- tokens_estimate > 10000 => route to SDR team "SDR-HighIntent"
- every registrant gets a follow-up sequence: email + 2-touch nurture + invite to sandbox.
Sarah (Product): abstracts needed by EOD Friday. Mike: 2-3 bullet demo script + expected outputs. Jordan/Priya pick one speaker slot.
Mike (APM): will drop demo script here by Thurs. Quick note: live command we'll use for the demo:
`curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-cache-v1","input":"prefix test","max_tokens":64}'`
Nate (Producer): I'll coordinate green-room checklist: mic test, VPN off, local firewall disabled, backup video cued. also setting up a backstage Slack call 30m before.
Alyssa (Growth): landing page copy — short hero + 3 bullets: "practical configs, measurable savings, live demo". i'll draft copy and share tomorrow.
Erica (Marketing): okay next actions: Mike upload clip + demo script by Thu, Sarah circulate speaker slate + abstracts by Fri EOD, Alyssa draft LP by Tue. Nate to confirm rehearsal slot via calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Nate (Producer): confirmed. sending invites now.
Erica (Marketing): thanks team — keeping this lean will help sell value quickly. we'll iterate on the narrative after rehearsal. :sparkles:
